about.description:
Rattler is a library that provides common functionality used within the conda
ecosystem. The goal of the library is to enable programs and other libraries to
easily interact with the conda ecosystem without being dependent on Python. Its
primary use case is as a library that you can use to provide conda related
workflows in your own tools.
about.summary: A blazing fast library to work with the conda ecosystem

script.content:
# Remove this wrapper once https://github.com/conda-forge/rust-activation-feedstock/pull/79 is merged
if [[ "$target_platform" == win-* ]]; then
  echo 'cargo auditable %*' > "$BUILD_PREFIX/Library/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
  export CARGO="cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
else
  mkdir -p "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin"
  printf '#!/usr/bin/env sh\nexec cargo auditable "$@"\n' > "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
  chmod +x "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
  export CARGO="cargo-auditable-wrapper"
fi

# native-tls uses the conda openssl on Linux and Schannel on Windows,
# both of which negotiate TLS 1.3. On macOS it uses Apple's deprecated
# SecureTransport API, which never implemented TLS 1.3, so servers that
# require TLS 1.3 fail with "bad protocol version"
# (https://github.com/conda/rattler/issues/2749). Use rustls there,
# which is also what the PyPI wheels ship.
if [[ "$target_platform" == osx-* ]]; then
  export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="--no-default-features --features=rustls"
else
  export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="--no-default-features --features=native-tls"
fi

if [[ "$target_platform" == win-* ]]; then
  export PYO3_PYTHON="$PYTHON"
  export CMAKE_GENERATOR="NMake Makefiles"
  export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="$MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS --jobs 1"
elif [[ "$target_platform" == linux-* ]]; then
  export OPENSSL_DIR="$PREFIX"
fi

if [[ "$target_platform" == "win-arm64" ]]; then
  # Keep CMake's object paths below Windows' limit.
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TMP/py-rattler-cargo-target"
  export CARGO_HOME="$TMP/py-rattler-cargo-home"

  # Use CMake for aws-lc-sys and clang-cl for its ARM64 assembly.
  export AWS_LC_SYS_CMAKE_BUILDER=1
  export CC_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
  export CXX_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
  export ASM_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
  export CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja
fi

# rust-lld (LLD) cannot handle some of the relocations GCC emits for ppc64le
# (e.g. inline-PLT R_PPC64_PLTSEQ/PLTCALL), which breaks linking of C-based
# crates such as aws-lc-sys and libdbus-sys. Fall back to the GNU bfd linker on
# that platform, which handles these relocations. gcc honors the last
# -fuse-ld, so this overrides rustc's bundled rust-lld default.
if [[ "$target_platform" == "linux-ppc64le" ]]; then
  export CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS="${CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS:-} -C link-arg=-fuse-ld=bfd"
fi

# Run the maturin build via pip which works for direct and
# cross-compiled builds.
"$PYTHON" -m pip install . -vv

cd py-rattler
cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.26.0"

recipe:
  name: py-rattler
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/py-rattler/py_rattler-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 247a3993dbeb1ec033cc8b6eef076997a7a85c7127a940a8baaafd903c1a243e

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: py-rattler
    build:
      skip:
        - is_abi3 and not is_python_min
        - not is_abi3 and target_platform == "linux-ppc64le"
      script:
        interpreter: brush
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
        content: |
          # Remove this wrapper once https://github.com/conda-forge/rust-activation-feedstock/pull/79 is merged
          if [[ "$target_platform" == win-* ]]; then
            echo 'cargo auditable %*' > "$BUILD_PREFIX/Library/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
            export CARGO="cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
          else
            mkdir -p "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin"
            printf '#!/usr/bin/env sh\nexec cargo auditable "$@"\n' > "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
            chmod +x "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
            export CARGO="cargo-auditable-wrapper"
          fi

          # native-tls uses the conda openssl on Linux and Schannel on Windows,
          # both of which negotiate TLS 1.3. On macOS it uses Apple's deprecated
          # SecureTransport API, which never implemented TLS 1.3, so servers that
          # require TLS 1.3 fail with "bad protocol version"
          # (https://github.com/conda/rattler/issues/2749). Use rustls there,
          # which is also what the PyPI wheels ship.
          if [[ "$target_platform" == osx-* ]]; then
            export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="--no-default-features --features=rustls"
          else
            export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="--no-default-features --features=native-tls"
          fi

          if [[ "$target_platform" == win-* ]]; then
            export PYO3_PYTHON="$PYTHON"
            export CMAKE_GENERATOR="NMake Makefiles"
            export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="$MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS --jobs 1"
          elif [[ "$target_platform" == linux-* ]]; then
            export OPENSSL_DIR="$PREFIX"
          fi

          if [[ "$target_platform" == "win-arm64" ]]; then
            # Keep CMake's object paths below Windows' limit.
            export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TMP/py-rattler-cargo-target"
            export CARGO_HOME="$TMP/py-rattler-cargo-home"

            # Use CMake for aws-lc-sys and clang-cl for its ARM64 assembly.
            export AWS_LC_SYS_CMAKE_BUILDER=1
            export CC_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
            export CXX_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
            export ASM_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
            export CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja
          fi

          # rust-lld (LLD) cannot handle some of the relocations GCC emits for ppc64le
          # (e.g. inline-PLT R_PPC64_PLTSEQ/PLTCALL), which breaks linking of C-based
          # crates such as aws-lc-sys and libdbus-sys. Fall back to the GNU bfd linker on
          # that platform, which handles these relocations. gcc honors the last
          # -fuse-ld, so this overrides rustc's bundled rust-lld default.
          if [[ "$target_platform" == "linux-ppc64le" ]]; then
            export CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS="${CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS:-} -C link-arg=-fuse-ld=bfd"
          fi

          # Run the maturin build via pip which works for direct and
          # cross-compiled builds.
          "$PYTHON" -m pip install . -vv

          cd py-rattler
          cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
      python:
        version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - maturin >=1.2.2,<2
        - brush
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - cargo-auditable
        - if: target_platform == "win-arm64"
          then:
            - cmake
            - ninja
      host:
        - python
        - if: is_abi3
          then: python-abi3
        - maturin >=1.2.2,<2
        - pip
        - if: linux
          then:
            - openssl
      run:
        - python
      extras:
        networkx:
          - networkx
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - rattler
          python_version:
            - if: is_abi3
              then: ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
      - if: is_abi3
        then:
          script:
            - if: win
              then: abi3audit %SP_DIR%/rattler/rattler.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
              else: abi3audit $SP_DIR/rattler/rattler.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
          requirements:
            run:
              - abi3audit

  - package:
      name: py_rattler
    build:
      noarch: generic
      skip: not (target_platform == "linux-64" and is_abi3 and is_python_min)
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('py-rattler', upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - rattler
    about:
      license_file: []

  homepage: https://github.com/conda/rattler
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:

    - py-rattler/THIRDPARTY.yml
  summary: A blazing fast library to work with the conda ecosystem
  description: |
    Rattler is a library that provides common functionality used within the conda
    ecosystem. The goal of the library is to enable programs and other libraries to
    easily interact with the conda ecosystem without being dependent on Python. Its
    primary use case is as a library that you can use to provide conda related

script.content:
# Remove this wrapper once https://github.com/conda-forge/rust-activation-feedstock/pull/79 is merged
if [[ "$target_platform" == win-* ]]; then
  echo 'cargo auditable %*' > "$BUILD_PREFIX/Library/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
  export CARGO="cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
else
  mkdir -p "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin"
  printf '#!/usr/bin/env sh\nexec cargo auditable "$@"\n' > "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
  chmod +x "$BUILD_PREFIX/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
  export CARGO="cargo-auditable-wrapper"
fi

# native-tls uses the conda openssl on Linux and Schannel on Windows,
# both of which negotiate TLS 1.3. On macOS it uses Apple's deprecated
# SecureTransport API, which never implemented TLS 1.3, so servers that
# require TLS 1.3 fail with "bad protocol version"
# (https://github.com/conda/rattler/issues/2749). Use rustls there,
# which is also what the PyPI wheels ship.
if [[ "$target_platform" == osx-* ]]; then
  export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="--no-default-features --features=rustls"
else
  export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="--no-default-features --features=native-tls"
fi

if [[ "$target_platform" == win-* ]]; then
  export PYO3_PYTHON="$PYTHON"
  export CMAKE_GENERATOR="NMake Makefiles"
  export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="$MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS --jobs 1"
elif [[ "$target_platform" == linux-* ]]; then
  export OPENSSL_DIR="$PREFIX"
fi

if [[ "$target_platform" == "win-arm64" ]]; then
  # Keep CMake's object paths below Windows' limit.
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TMP/py-rattler-cargo-target"
  export CARGO_HOME="$TMP/py-rattler-cargo-home"

  # Use CMake for aws-lc-sys and clang-cl for its ARM64 assembly.
  export AWS_LC_SYS_CMAKE_BUILDER=1
  export CC_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
  export CXX_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
  export ASM_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=clang-cl.exe
  export CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja
fi

# rust-lld (LLD) cannot handle some of the relocations GCC emits for ppc64le
# (e.g. inline-PLT R_PPC64_PLTSEQ/PLTCALL), which breaks linking of C-based
# crates such as aws-lc-sys and libdbus-sys. Fall back to the GNU bfd linker on
# that platform, which handles these relocations. gcc honors the last
# -fuse-ld, so this overrides rustc's bundled rust-lld default.
if [[ "$target_platform" == "linux-ppc64le" ]]; then
  export CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS="${CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS:-} -C link-arg=-fuse-ld=bfd"
fi

# Run the maturin build via pip which works for direct and
# cross-compiled builds.
"$PYTHON" -m pip install . -vv

cd py-rattler
cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
